rootCauseOneLine: Three of the 11 listed surfaces really map unbounded/huge arrays into small scroll boxes (CSV preview mounts all 50,000 td of its 500x100 cap; prompt-banner WorkspaceChangesList mounts one row per changed file even while collapsed and the status payload is unbounded; RemotePathBrowser renders every readdir entry); the other 8 are bounded upstream, tiny in practice, an unused container, or a misread of the pagination helper.
proposedFix: (1) Virtualize CSV preview tbody rows (and optionally columns) with the already-used @tanstack/react-virtual over the existing scroll container, keeping sticky thead; interim content-visibility:auto on tr helps layout but not memory. (2) In ThreadPromptContextBanner, don't mount the git body while collapsed and pass `limit` to WorkspaceChangesList (metadata panel already does) or virtualize; additionally cap WorkspaceStatus.workingTree.files at the daemon boundary with maxFiles/truncated like WORKSPACE_DIFF_MAX_FILES (protocol version bump). (3) Add a limit/truncated pair to the daemon directory-listing command used by RemotePathBrowser (protocol version bump) and virtualize the h-56 list. Leave small-data surfaces alone; close command.tsx and resource-pagination.tsx entries as false positives.
caveats: No iOS device/simulator available; measurements are headless Chromium 145 (dev build and a production `vite preview` build) with 1x and 4x CPU throttling as a phone stand-in. Worktree HEAD was a108fa7ef (5 commits past base); I checked out 16ceb3a54 for all work; nothing on origin/main since fixes this. The repro vitest file passes on main (documents current behavior) rather than failing. `dev-browser --browser bb1615 stop` stopped the shared dev-browser daemon (other agents' named pages may have been closed; the daemon auto-restarts on next use).
